current_fixed_front_budget.scope: single fixed straight Mode-I front; not a two-state growth budget

review_findings.global_front_layout: MIXED93_BASE81_GLOBAL12; fixed single straight front benchmark

toy_fracture_parameters.classification: toy bridge parameters; not calibrated material data

recommended_mainline.name: bind-current-driving-field
recommended_mainline.input: actual parent ExplicitSurfaceState, real solved field, current J result, real Gc provenance
recommended_mainline.gate: same surface/field/source/solver hashes; current coupled mode; contour and path sensitivity checked
recommended_mainline.failure: UNKNOWN or NEEDS_RECOMPUTE; keep parent active

recommended_mainline.name: propose-one-bounded-strip
recommended_mainline.input: caller-requested geometric advance, +x frame, finite step cap, domain bounds
recommended_mainline.gate: G<Gc arrests; G=Gc holds; G>Gc creates one geometry-only immutable candidate
recommended_mainline.failure: no candidate commit or automatic second step

recommended_mainline.name: rebuild-candidate-basis-and-geometry
recommended_mainline.input: candidate front geometry and immutable history mapping
recommended_mainline.gate: re-evaluate candidate basis/gradients/MLS/quadrature/assembly; bind new generation/hash; never treat old coefficients as a candidate solution

recommended_mainline.name: equilibrate-old-and-candidate-under-identical-physical-load
recommended_mainline.input: verified parent equilibrium (or solve it) and candidate reanalysis
recommended_mainline.gate: same real load/material/boundary control; candidate state contains all solved side displacement arrays; converged and stable branch
recommended_mainline.failure: not converged/stable or receipt mismatch => NEEDS_RECOMPUTE; preserve parent

recommended_mainline.name: close-complete-energy-ledger
recommended_mainline.input: delta stored, external work, chosen fracture dissipation, area, gauge/support work, explicit tolerance basis
recommended_mainline.gate: choose either quasi-static Griffith Gc*delta_area gate or a separate cohesive-history dissipation gate; never count the same cohesive fracture twice
recommended_mainline.failure: missing terms, wrong units, ambiguous total-potential mapping, excess residual, dynamic/mixed/unstable => UNKNOWN or NEEDS_RECOMPUTE

recommended_mainline.name: one-terminal-state
recommended_mainline.input: candidate-bound current external reanalysis plus selected energy gate
recommended_mainline.failure: reject or preserve active parent; no automatic next step

quasistatic_griffith_gate_v2.assumption: no inertia and no other dissipation

cohesive_history_gate.gc_delta_area: must not be separately subtracted for the same already-counted cohesive fracture dissipation

gauge_work.required_resolution: same zero-target pure gauge with zero work, or audited incremental reaction work included with a derived sign convention; otherwise UNKNOWN

parallelizable_design_work.name: current-J-receipt-contract
parallelizable_design_work.deliverable: field/source/solver/parent hash bindings plus current contour/path sensitivity schema and mode check

parallelizable_design_work.name: moving-front-basis-budget
parallelizable_design_work.deliverable: candidate-tip MLS/basis/quadrature rebuild inventory, reusable-cache proof, bounded query/memory estimates

parallelizable_design_work.name: physical-energy-and-gauge-convention
parallelizable_design_work.deliverable: sign-reviewed external boundary/support work, stored/cohesive energy and once-counted area definition

parallelizable_design_work.name: external-reanalysis-receipt
parallelizable_design_work.deliverable: candidate exact-geometry, same-load, both-side displacement and stability/convergence proof binding
